{"affected_statement":"L3.3","objection_correct":"yes","established_elsewhere":"yes","elsewhere_quote":"Liu uses exactly \(n\) marks to create, in order, the interval lengths

\[
\delta,2\delta,4\delta,\ldots,2^n\delta.
\]","status_as_written":"false_display","repair_distance":"symbol","explanation":"The objection correctly computes the cumulative marks as \((2^j-1)\delta\), not \(2^j\delta\). However, the preceding sentence explicitly specifies the intended binary interval lengths, and the subsequent subset-sum argument establishes the universal lower bound from those lengths. Thus L3.3 is established despite the erroneous displayed endpoint formula. Inserting “\(-1\)” repairs it."}
